title: Chaos Agent
description: One run of the Chaos Agent at a time: what it does now, what the agent says, what users saw, the verdicts, the model's tokens and memory; and every run before it.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, '#' || id || '  ' || model || '  ' || status || '  ' || to_char(created_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text FROM runs ORDER BY id DESC

target.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM s.started_at) * 1000 AS time, extract(epoch FROM coalesce(s.finished_at, now())) * 1000 AS timeend,
       'step ' || s.step || ': ' || (s.input->'action'->>'type') || ' ' || coalesce(s.input->'action'->>'name', s.input->'action'->>'zone', s.input->'action'->>'node', '') || ' (' || coalesce(s.output->>'verdict', 'running') || ')' AS text,
       coalesce(s.output->>'verdict', 'running') AS tags
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name = 'run_experiment' AND s.allowed

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM runs WHERE id = $run
SELECT model FROM runs WHERE id = $run
SELECT round((extract(epoch FROM coalesce(finished_at, now()) - started_at) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS minutes FROM runs WHERE id = $run

panels.title: Experiments
panels.description: Every run_experiment of the run by the judge's verdict. not_run: the system never got steady, nothing was changed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' IN ('broke','withstood','inconclusive')) AS experiments,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'broke') AS broke,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'withstood') AS withstood,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'inconclusive') AS inconclusive,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'not_run') AS not_run
FROM steps WHERE run_id = $run AND name = 'run_experiment'

panels.title: Model use
panels.description: cost_usd from the tokens of every model call (prices as in eval/score.py). cache_hit_pct: the share of input tokens read from the prompt cache.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS rounds, round(sum((CASE s.name
  WHEN 'claude-haiku-5-5' THEN (coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*0.50
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.01 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*0.125)
       * CASE WHEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)+coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)+coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0) > 100000 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END
  WHEN 'claude-sonnet-5-5' THEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*2.0 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*10.0
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*2.50
  END) / 1000000.0)::numeric, 3) AS cost_usd, round(100.0 * sum(s.cache_read_tokens) / nullif(sum(coalesce(s.tokens_in,0) + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0) + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_pct
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.kind = 'llm'

panels.title: Safety
panels.description: denied: calls the orchestrator refused (RoE, scope, unknown tools). pending_undos: changes not restored yet; must be 0 when no experiment runs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM steps WHERE run_id = $run AND NOT allowed AND name <> 'read_tools_missing') AS denied,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM undo_actions WHERE run_id = $run AND status = 'pending') AS pending_undos

panels.title: Last step
panels.description: What the orchestrator is doing right now: the last step recorded. A model call shows as the model's name.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.step, s.name AS doing,
       CASE WHEN s.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'running for ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - s.started_at)) || ' s'
            ELSE 'done' END AS state, s.started_at AS started
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run ORDER BY s.step DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Current experiment
panels.description: The last experiment the agent asked for, with its hypothesis. verdict is running until the orchestrator has measured, restored and judged it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.step, (s.input->'action'->>'type') || ' ' || coalesce(s.input->'action'->>'name', s.input->'action'->>'zone', s.input->'action'->>'node', '') AS action, coalesce((s.input->'action'->'patch')::text, '') AS patch,
       s.input->'journeys' AS journeys, s.input->>'restore_after_s' AS restore_after_s,
       coalesce(s.output->>'verdict', 'running') AS verdict, s.input->>'hypothesis' AS hypothesis
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name = 'run_experiment' ORDER BY s.step DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: What the agent says and does
Agent
panels.description: Every model response of the run, newest first: its text, and each tool it called with the input. The last text of a finished run is its summary.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.step, s.finished_at AS time,
       CASE e.b->>'type'
         WHEN 'text' THEN e.b->>'text'
         WHEN 'thinking' THEN '(thinking) ' || (e.b->>'thinking')
         WHEN 'tool_use' THEN 'calls ' || (e.b->>'name') || ' ' || (e.b->'input')::text
       END AS agent
FROM steps s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.output) = 'array' THEN s.output ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
     WITH ORDINALITY AS e(b, i)
WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.kind = 'llm' AND e.b->>'type' IN ('text', 'thinking', 'tool_use')
ORDER BY s.step DESC, e.i

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Every call the orchestrator made for the run, through the MCP servers or its own tools, newest first. allowed false: refused before it left the orchestrator. Output is cut at 400 characters; inspect a cell for all of it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.step, s.name AS tool, s.allowed, s.started_at AS started,
       round(extract(epoch FROM s.finished_at - s.started_at)::numeric, 1) AS seconds,
       left(coalesce(s.output::text, 'running'), 400) AS output
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.kind = 'tool' ORDER BY s.step DESC

panels.title: What users saw: the k6 measurements

options.content:
Every point is **one second**, by the second the users **arrived**, for one journey.

k6 sends `new_users_per_second` new users per journey every second, whatever the system does, from inside the probe pod. Each measurement is a steady check (before every experiment) or an experiment's own measurement; the vertical marks are the experiments, from the agent's request until the verdict.

- **p95**: the slowest requests of that second. Above the steady state's `p95_ms` (`target.yaml`) the second is **slow** (`s` in the timeline).
- **Failed users**: users whose journey failed, by an HTTP error or no answer in time. A failed second is `x`.
- **The judge** does not count bad seconds one by one: it learns the application's own noise from the seconds before every action, and calls an experiment **broke** only when the seconds after the action are worse than that noise would make (ADR-0036). `noise_rate` in the experiments table is what it expected.

A measurement is stored when k6 finishes it, so the newest experiment's seconds appear once it is measured.

panels.title: p95 latency per journey (ms)
panels.description: The red line is the steady state of the lab's target.yaml (500 ms); change the threshold for another application.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp((s.output->'content'->>'started_at')::float8 + (sec->>'second')::int) AS time, j.key AS metric, (j.value->>'p95_ms')::float8 AS value 
FROM steps s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'content'->'seconds') sec
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(sec->'journeys') j
WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name LIKE '%measure_journeys' AND coalesce((s.output->>'is_error')::boolean, false) = false
  AND jsonb_typeof(s.output->'content'->'seconds') = 'array' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failed users per second, per journey

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp((s.output->'content'->>'started_at')::float8 + (sec->>'second')::int) AS time, j.key AS metric, (j.value->>'failed')::int AS value 
FROM steps s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'content'->'seconds') sec
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(sec->'journeys') j
WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name LIKE '%measure_journeys' AND coalesce((s.output->>'is_error')::boolean, false) = false
  AND jsonb_typeof(s.output->'content'->'seconds') = 'array' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: How the failed users failed over the whole run: an HTTP status (fast errors) or timeout (no answer in fail_request_after_s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT j.key AS journey, e.key AS error, sum((e.value)::int) AS users
FROM steps s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'content'->'seconds') sec
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(sec->'journeys') j
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(coalesce(j.value->'errors', '{}'::jsonb)) e
WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name LIKE '%measure_journeys' AND jsonb_typeof(s.output->'content'->'seconds') = 'array'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Successful users per second, per journey

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp((s.output->'content'->>'started_at')::float8 + (sec->>'second')::int) AS time, j.key AS metric, (j.value->>'ok')::int AS value 
FROM steps s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'content'->'seconds') sec
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(sec->'journeys') j
WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name LIKE '%measure_journeys' AND coalesce((s.output->>'is_error')::boolean, false) = false
  AND jsonb_typeof(s.output->'content'->'seconds') = 'array' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Experiments
panels.description: One row per journey of every experiment. timeline: one character per second, . ok, s slow, x failed, _ no users, | the action and the restore. bad_s: bad seconds after the action; in_a_row: the longest run of them; noise_rate: the share of bad seconds the judge expected from the application's own noise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.step, (s.input->'action'->>'type') || ' ' || coalesce(s.input->'action'->>'name', s.input->'action'->>'zone', s.input->'action'->>'node', '') AS action, coalesce((s.input->'action'->'patch')::text, '') AS patch,
       coalesce(s.output->>'verdict', 'running') AS verdict, j.key AS journey, j.value->>'timeline' AS timeline,
       (j.value->>'broken_s')::int AS bad_s, (j.value->>'longest_broken_s')::int AS in_a_row,
       j.value->>'recovered_after_s' AS recovered_after_s, j.value->>'noise_rate' AS noise_rate,
       (j.value->'after_action'->'errors')::text AS errors,
       coalesce(s.output->>'reason', s.output->>'error', '') AS reason, s.input->>'hypothesis' AS hypothesis
FROM steps s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.output->'journeys') = 'object' THEN s.output->'journeys' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) j ON true
WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name = 'run_experiment'
ORDER BY s.step DESC, j.key

panels.title: The model: tokens, caching and memory
Tokens per model call
panels.description: Every model call of the run. The prompt cache keeps the system prompt and the conversation so far: what is read from it costs a tenth of new input, so most of every call's input should be 'read from cache' once the run is going.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.finished_at AS time, s.tokens_in AS "input, not cached", s.cache_read_tokens AS "read from cache",
       s.cache_write_tokens AS "written to cache", s.tokens_out AS output
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.kind = 'llm' ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.finished_at AS time, sum((CASE s.name
  WHEN 'claude-haiku-5-5' THEN (coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*0.50
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.01 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*0.125)
       * CASE WHEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)+coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)+coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0) > 100000 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END
  WHEN 'claude-sonnet-5-5' THEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*2.0 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*10.0
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*2.50
  END) / 1000000.0) OVER (ORDER BY s.step) AS cost_usd
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.kind = 'llm' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: searches: how often the agent searched what earlier runs found (search_knowledge). remembered_at_the_end: chunks this run added to memory when it finished. chunks_in_memory: all that later runs on this application can search.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM steps WHERE run_id = $run AND name = 'search_knowledge') AS searches,
       (SELECT coalesce(sum((output->>'added')::int), 0) FROM steps WHERE run_id = $run AND name = 'index_knowledge') AS remembered_at_the_end,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE namespace = (SELECT namespace FROM runs WHERE id = $run)) AS chunks_in_memory

panels.title: What the agent searched in memory
panels.description: Retrieval (ADR-0033): every search_knowledge call, with what it found. closest is the distance in meaning of the best result (lower is closer). experiment results are facts from measurements; summary results are an earlier agent's conclusions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.step, s.started_at AS time, s.input->>'query' AS query, coalesce(s.input->>'workload', '') AS workload,
       jsonb_array_length(coalesce(s.output->'results', '[]'::jsonb)) AS results,
       (SELECT round(min((r->>'distance')::numeric), 3) FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.output->'results', '[]'::jsonb)) r) AS closest,
       (SELECT string_agg('run ' || (r->>'run_id') || coalesce(' step ' || (r->>'step'), '') || ' (' || (r->>'kind') || ')', ', ')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.output->'results', '[]'::jsonb)) r) AS found,
       coalesce(s.output->>'error', '') AS error
FROM steps s WHERE s.run_id = $run AND s.name = 'search_knowledge' ORDER BY s.step DESC

panels.title: Runs (click a run to open it)
panels.description: Every run, newest first. Click a run number to open it on its own time range. Runs without a model (baseline, verify) have no rounds or cost. Recall against the ground truth is scored by eval/score.py, not here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (SELECT run_id,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' IN ('broke','withstood','inconclusive')) AS experiments,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'broke') AS broke,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'withstood') AS withstood,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'inconclusive') AS inconclusive
           FROM steps WHERE name = 'run_experiment' GROUP BY run_id),
     l AS (SELECT s.run_id, count(*) AS rounds, sum((CASE s.name
  WHEN 'claude-haiku-5-5' THEN (coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*0.50
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.01 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*0.125)
       * CASE WHEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)+coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)+coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0) > 100000 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END
  WHEN 'claude-sonnet-5-5' THEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*2.0 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*10.0
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*2.50
  END) / 1000000.0) AS cost, round(100.0 * sum(s.cache_read_tokens) / nullif(sum(coalesce(s.tokens_in,0) + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0) + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_pct
           FROM steps s WHERE s.kind = 'llm' GROUP BY s.run_id),
     k AS (SELECT run_id, count(*) AS searches FROM steps WHERE name = 'search_knowledge' GROUP BY run_id)
SELECT r.id AS run, r.model, r.status, r.namespace, r.started_at AS started,
       round((extract(epoch FROM coalesce(r.finished_at, now()) - r.started_at) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS minutes,
       coalesce(e.experiments, 0) AS experiments, coalesce(e.broke, 0) AS broke, coalesce(e.withstood, 0) AS withstood,
       coalesce(e.inconclusive, 0) AS inconclusive, coalesce(k.searches, 0) AS memory_searches,
       coalesce(l.rounds, 0) AS rounds, round(coalesce(l.cost, 0)::numeric, 3) AS cost_usd, l.cache_hit_pct,
       (extract(epoch FROM r.started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS from_ms,
       (extract(epoch FROM coalesce(r.finished_at, now())) * 1000 + 60000)::bigint AS to_ms
FROM runs r LEFT JOIN e ON e.run_id = r.id LEFT JOIN l ON l.run_id = r.id LEFT JOIN k ON k.run_id = r.id
ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT '#' || run_id AS run,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'broke') AS broke,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'withstood') AS withstood,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE output->>'verdict' = 'inconclusive') AS inconclusive
FROM steps WHERE name = 'run_experiment' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id

panels.title: Cost and memory per run
panels.description: The cost of every run with a model, beside how often it searched its memory of earlier runs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '#' || s.run_id AS run, round(sum((CASE s.name
  WHEN 'claude-haiku-5-5' THEN (coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*0.50
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.01 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*0.125)
       * CASE WHEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)+coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)+coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0) > 100000 THEN 5 ELSE 1 END
  WHEN 'claude-sonnet-5-5' THEN coalesce(s.tokens_in,0)*2.0 + coalesce(s.tokens_out,0)*10.0
       + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens,0)*0.10 + coalesce(s.cache_write_tokens,0)*2.50
  END) / 1000000.0)::numeric, 3) AS cost_usd,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM steps k WHERE k.run_id = s.run_id AND k.name = 'search_knowledge') AS memory_searches
FROM steps s WHERE s.kind = 'llm' GROUP BY s.run_id ORDER BY s.run_id
